pages.text: Teleports to the corresponding location in the Nether, and can teleport back to the Overworld from the Nether.$(br)An upgraded version of the $(l:goetymech_focuses/unstable_rift_focus)Unstable Rift Focus$(/l), this focus allows free traversal between the Overworld and the Nether.$(br)Useful for evading attacks or covering long distances. Unlike the Unstable Rift Focus, the Stable Rift Focus seeks out safe coordinates in the Nether — if the corresponding coordinates are too dangerous, it teleports the user to the bedrock layer instead.$(br)$(4)"The Nether Star stabilizes the passage between realms, freeing dimensional travel from the constraints of ancient portals."$()
